chunks.title: LEQ — Long Essay Question (6 points) — Q4 Set 1: Discoveries and Benefits to Individuals/Societies
chunks.content: AP World History LEQ, 6 points, standardized rubric. A Thesis/Claim [1]. B Contextualization [1]. C Evidence [0–2]: two specific pieces (1), used to support the argument (1). D Analysis and Reasoning [0–2]: reasoning process (causation/CCOT) (1), complex understanding (1). Q4 Set 1 prompt: discoveries and their benefits to individuals/societies. Common failure: brief context; evidence not tied to the argument; reasoning without complexity.

chunks.content: Q4 (Set 1) scored 4/6 (Thesis 1, Context 0, Evidence 2, Analysis 1). Earned the thesis, both Evidence points, and one Analysis point. Lost contextualization and the Complexity point. A common 4-point profile: strong thesis/evidence, weak context, no complexity.
